newsitem.title: USA: Uno Restaurant begins dutch auction tender.
newsitem.headline: Uno Restaurant begins dutch auction tender.

text.p: Uno Restaurant Corp said Thursday that it will begin a "dutch auction" tender offer for up to one million shares of common stock, representing about 8.2 percent of its currently outstanding shares.
Under the terms of the offer, Uno said it will invite stockholders to tender their shares at prices specified by the tendering shareholders within a range of $6 to $7.50 per share.
The tender offer begins today and will expire at 1700 EDT (2100 GMT) on July 21.
The company said it will select a single per share purchase price within the $6 to $7.50 price range based upon the number of shares tendered and the prices specified by tendering stockholders.

If the offer is over-subscribed, shares will be purchased first from shares unconditionally tendered at or below the purchase price on a pro rata basis and then from shares unconditionally tendered at or below the purchase price selected by lot.

Uno said it reserves the right to purchase more than one million shares, and under certain circumstances, less than one million shares. The tender offer is not conditioned on any minimum number of shares being tendered.
